suite: S3-VIS-01 Menu Ingestion Controlled Integration Test Scenarios

scenarios.title: Normal PDF and Photo Menu Ingestion
scenarios.expected_queue_behavior: Queue receives message { version: 1, tenantId, jobId, queuedAt } and assigns to worker consumer with lease.
scenarios.expected_extraction_behavior: Worker calls hosted Python /extract with Bearer token, X-Job-ID, X-Tenant-ID, and minted 15-minute X-Source-Capability. Subprocess completes within 700s, HTTP returns within 720s.
scenarios.expected_r2_behavior: Complete raw extraction result written to reports/00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000001/11111111-1111-1111-1111-111111111111/extraction.json.
scenarios.expected_database_behavior: Job status transitions queued -> running -> complete; 3 dish drafts persisted with extraction_status='needs_review' and review_status='pending'; lease claim released.
scenarios.expected_ack_retry_dlq_behavior: msg.ack() called exactly once after report written and drafts committed. Zero retries; no DLQ routing.

scenarios.title: Expected Extraction and Draft Output Fidelity
scenarios.expected_extraction_behavior: Validates schema_version 2, pipeline_version '3', producing exactly 3 drafts and 3 segments with coordinate metadata.
scenarios.expected_r2_behavior: Report JSON matches ExtractionReportSchema v2 contract with segment and evidence arrays.
scenarios.expected_database_behavior: Persists Garden Soup ($8.50 / 12.50 CAD), Coffee (unpriced), and Bread (0.00 CAD) with unique draft_index [0, 1, 2] and evidence spans linking to page 1.
scenarios.expected_ack_retry_dlq_behavior: Successful ACK after drafts and report verified.

scenarios.title: Transient Failure, Bounded Retry, and DLQ Routing
scenarios.expected_queue_behavior: Worker encounters 504 extraction_timeout or network failure; invokes msg.retry() on attempts 0, 1, 2.
scenarios.expected_extraction_behavior: Extraction transport aborts after timeout budget without holding database lease past 15 minutes.
scenarios.expected_r2_behavior: No report written to R2 on extraction failure.
scenarios.expected_database_behavior: failIngestionJob updates error_code='extraction_timeout', releases claim_token and locked_at; status remains 'queued' while attempt_count < 3, then marks status='failed' when attempt_count reaches max_attempts (3).
scenarios.expected_ack_retry_dlq_behavior: msg.retry() called without ACK; after 3 retries (4 total attempts), Cloudflare Queue routes poison/exhausted message to peekaplate-staging-menu-ingestion-dlq.

scenarios.title: Idempotency Consistency and Conflict Rejection
scenarios.expected_queue_behavior: No queue message emitted for rejected conflict submission.
scenarios.expected_extraction_behavior: Extractor is not invoked on conflict.
scenarios.expected_database_behavior: Initial submission creates job. Second submission with conflicting hash fails with HTTP 409 Conflict (idempotency_conflict). Re-submission with identical hash returns existing job safely (HTTP 200).
scenarios.expected_ack_retry_dlq_behavior: Duplicate queue messages for already running or complete jobs are safely ACKed to avoid duplicate work.

scenarios.title: R2 Report Storage Failure Prevents Draft Persistence and Premature ACK
scenarios.expected_queue_behavior: Queue message processing throws IngestionError('report_storage_failed'); triggers msg.retry().
scenarios.expected_extraction_behavior: Extraction succeeded, but report cannot be persisted.
scenarios.expected_database_behavior: Database drafts are NOT persisted; persistExtractedDrafts is never called; job is failed with error_code='report_storage_failed'; lease released.
scenarios.expected_ack_retry_dlq_behavior: msg.retry() called; msg.ack() is NEVER called. Message will be retried when storage recovers.

scenarios.title: Cross-Tenant / Cross-Venue Access Denial
scenarios.expected_queue_behavior: Queue messages strictly bind tenantId from authenticated submitter.
scenarios.expected_extraction_behavior: Capability token binds tenantId; mismatched tenant cannot read another tenant's private source in R2.
scenarios.expected_r2_behavior: Sources and reports are path-scoped under tenant UUID: menu-ingestion/sources/{tenantId}/... and reports/{tenantId}/....
scenarios.expected_database_behavior: All SQL queries include AND tenant_id = $tenantId. Attempt by Tenant A to claim, fetch, or approve Tenant B's job or draft returns 404/403.
scenarios.expected_ack_retry_dlq_behavior: Foreign tenant message cannot modify state of another tenant's jobs.

scenarios.title: Strict Atomic Processing Sequence Before ACK
scenarios.expected_queue_behavior: Batch consumer invokes handler with exactly one message.
scenarios.expected_extraction_behavior: Extractor executes and returns valid MenuExtractionResult.
scenarios.expected_r2_behavior: Report put to R2 occurs BEFORE database draft transaction.
scenarios.expected_database_behavior: persistExtractedDrafts runs within lease fence: writes dish drafts, updates job status='complete', sets result_storage_key, releases claim_token.
scenarios.expected_ack_retry_dlq_behavior: msg.ack() called strictly AFTER both R2 write and database draft transaction succeed. If any step fails, msg.retry() is called instead.
